description: Quote-fidelity corpus (VER-R5): claim wording vs stored caption text — fidelity to the RECORD we hold, never to audio. Known ASR hazard classes with expected treatments. Caption text is a claim pointer, never evidence for a quoted number (ADR-0007): numerical claims route to the stat-grid regardless of caption wording.

artefacts.claimText: Unemployment is at a record low of 3.2 percent.
artefacts.captionText: FINANCE MINISTER: Unemployment is at a record low of three too percent.

expected.note: ASR artefact: 'three two' transcribed as 'three too'; wording-critical claim — verification limited to the quoted claim, caption_quality_flag set

artefacts.claimText: The Minister said, We will not raise taxes.
artefacts.captionText: FINANCE MINISTER: we will not raise taxes

expected.note: punctuation and case differences are not fidelity failures; the quote matches the stored caption verbatim modulo case/punctuation

artefacts.claimText: We've invested 200 million dollars in youth employment.
artefacts.captionText: FINANCE MINISTER: We've invested $200 million in youth employment

expected.note: number formatting matches but the claim is numerical — routes to stat-grid mode; caption wording never evidences a number (ADR-0007 non-negotiable)

artefacts.captionText: KAI: te titiri obligations were discussed

expected.note: te reo passage mis-transcribed ('titiri'); known ASR hazard — flagged, verification limited to the quoted claim

artefacts.claimText: The Minister made an extraordinary claim about immigration.
artefacts.captionText: KAI: The Minister made extraordinary claims about immigration

expected.reason: claim cannot be anchored to a cue span — publishes as an open question, never a verdict with a dead-end quote (VERIFICATION §2.4 step 4)
